text:
Sam C: FYI NimbleQ QBR prep 1 overnight embed surge doubled daily units. need a short triage for the deck.
Priya S: saw it on the dashboard, window ~00:45-03:15 UTC, mostly /v1/embeddings.
Dan L: theyre on monthly credits + small overage cap. renewal in ~5wks, want to avoid a surprise.
Priya S: quick 30d sketch:
```
Baseline: 110k embed units/day
Observed spike: 2x for ~2.5h/night
30d baseline cost: $26.4k
If spike persists nightly: ~$39.6k
Suggested safety retainer: ~$8k
```
Sam C: mitigation options to show in QBR: A) soft throttle on non-critical tokens B) one-month credit buffer + SE runbook.
Alex M: alert-bot can we create soft 75% alert + hard 90% escalate (email + webhook to #customer-success)?
alert-bot: created alerts: nimbleq-75pct (email: customer-success@redwood, nimbleq-admin@nimbleq.com), nimbleq-90pct (pager: oncall-billing), webhook -> #customer-success.
Priya S: note for slides: include base vs worst-case waterfall and a tiny appendix on reindex patterns + batching guidance.
Dan L: I'll ping their eng lead (samir@nimbleq.com) to confirm whether a nightly full reindex started.
Sam C: owners: Priya = numbers + slide, Dan = customer follow-up, Alex = alert config, Sam = draft mitigation text. anyone can own follow-up with Samir before EOD?
Dan L: taking it, will update when I hear back. :thumbsup:
